instruction.title: Mark Stress
instruction.text: In the text, VIEW shows you the stress of Russian words.

instruction.title: Click
instruction.text: Click on each stressed vowel in the Russian words you find in the text and VIEW will show you whether you guessed right or wrong.

instruction.title: Multiple Choice
instruction.text: Choose a Russian word with the correct stress from the drop-down list and VIEW will show you whether you guessed right or wrong. You can get help by clicking on ?.

instruction.title: Hover
instruction.text: VIEW will show you the correct stress for the Russian word marked in green when you hover over it.
